title: Blameless postmortems exist because fear hides causes
body: Etsy and Google popularised incident reviews that ask how the system let a reasonable person err, instead of naming a culprit. Punishing the messenger guarantees the next messenger stays silent and the latent condition survives. The rule is not kindness for its own sake; it is how you get the timeline that actually prevents recurrence.
source_hint: Google SRE Book; Etsy debriefing culture writings
